stories.summary: Together, the couple command hundreds of millions of social media followers and have expanded their brand beyond football through investments in fashion, hospitality and other business venture

article_sentences: Football icon Cristiano Ronaldo has married his long-time partner Georgina Rodriguez, bringing a decade-long relationship to a new chapter in a private ceremony on Portugal's Atlantic coast.
The couple exchanged vows on Tuesday in the seaside resort of Cascais, west of Lisbon, surrounded by their five children in what Ronaldo's representatives described as an intimate family celebration.
Ronaldo marked the occasion by posting a photo of the couple's wedding bands on Instagram with the caption, "C ❤️ G."
The wedding comes exactly one year after Rodriguez, a model and influencer, announced their engagement.
The pair first met in 2016 when Rodriguez was working at a Gucci store in Madrid, and have since become one of the world's most recognizable celebrity couples.
Now 41, Ronaldo currently plays for Saudi Arabian club Al Nassr after a career that included spells with Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus, as well as five Ballon d'Or awards.
Rodriguez has built her own global following through her Netflix series.
I Am Georgina, which chronicles the family's life.
Together, the couple command hundreds of millions of social media followers and have expanded their brand beyond football through investments in fashion, hospitality and other business ventures.

stories.title: Rescued kidnap victims in Nigeria recount ordeal during 6 months of captivity
stories.summary: After six months in captivity, victims of a mass kipnapping in Nigeria’s Kwara state have been recounting their ordeal. More than 100 people abducted from the Woro community were rescued by government forces earlier this month.

stories.title: Colombia quake rescuers save woman after 36 hours trapped in rubble
stories.summary: A 32-year-old woman has been rescued alive in Pereira after spending 36 hours trapped beneath a collapsed building. Rescuers located her 10 hours before reaching her.
